# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 1: Fourth Odyssey Act I — The Western Crossing (oe_ely_). Generated by gen_elysia_exodus.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Rule #13 Wrapper Triggers (stage plugs has_game_rule directly into these 3)
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Rule #13 is turned off (O(1) sleep; Dev override takes precedence).
oe_ely_rule_is_off = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off
		AND = {
			oe_rule_is_elysia_exodus_off = yes
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Rule #13 is set to Immediate 1337 Odyssey mode.
oe_ely_rule_is_immediate_1337 = {
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only }
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337
		oe_rule_is_elysia_exodus_immediate_1337 = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Rule #13 is set to default Exile-Only mode (1453/crisis trigger).
oe_ely_rule_is_exile_only = {
	NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_immediate_1337 = yes }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Host, Crisis, Faith & Bridgehead Triggers
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Valid Roman / Byzantine successor host (non-rebel BYZ, TRE, or FEO).
oe_ely_eligible_tag = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
		tag = TRE
		tag = FEO
	}
}

# Country scope. Active Nova Elysia state (compatible with both oe_ely_is_elysia & oe_ely_is_nova_elysia).
oe_ely_is_elysian_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
	}
}

# Country scope. Constantinople is no longer held by BYZ or ROM (owner-guarded).
oe_ely_constantinople_lost = {
	NOT = { owns = location:constantinople }
	NOT = {
		location:constantinople = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = {
				OR = {
					tag = BYZ
					tag = ROM
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Exile-Only mode crisis gate: never interferes with a strong healthy Byzantium.
oe_ely_old_world_crisis = {
	is_ai = no
	oe_ely_eligible_tag = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
	OR = {
		oe_l7_ex_eligible = yes
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1444
			oe_ely_constantinople_lost = yes
		}
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1444
			num_locations <= 4
			country_exists = c:TUR
			OR = {
				is_at_war_with = c:TUR
				location:constantinople = {
					has_owner = yes
					has_siege = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Immediate-1337 mode opening window (1337.6.1 - 1360 for human BYZ).
oe_ely_immediate_1337_ready = {
	oe_ely_rule_is_immediate_1337 = yes
	is_ai = no
	tag = BYZ
	is_rebel_country = no
	current_date >= 1337.6.1
	current_year <= 1360
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
}

# Country scope. Currently sailing across the Atlantic in Act I.
oe_ely_is_voyaging = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	has_variable = oe_ely_voyager
	has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
}

# Country scope. Eligible to launch or reconsider the Fourth Odyssey via manual decision.
oe_ely_can_launch_manual = {
	NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
	is_ai = no
	oe_ely_eligible_tag = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
	OR = {
		oe_ely_immediate_1337_ready = yes
		oe_ely_old_world_crisis = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. At least one Chesapeake bridgehead location is claimable (unowned or AI-owned).
oe_ely_chesapeake_claimable = {
	OR = {
		location:chesapeake = {
			is_ownable = yes
			OR = {
				has_owner = no
				AND = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = { is_ai = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			is_ownable = yes
			OR = {
				has_owner = no
				AND = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = { is_ai = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = {
			is_ownable = yes
			OR = {
				has_owner = no
				AND = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = { is_ai = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Safe religion checks (always guard exists = religion & religion ?=).
oe_ely_has_orthodox_faith = {
	exists = religion
	religion ?= religion:orthodox
}

oe_ely_has_hellenic_faith = {
	exists = religion
	religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
}
